propositions: executor.py exceeds 800 LOC hard cap with only 10 lines of headroom, requiring a seam-based split along architectural boundaries
The step-kind I/O contract model (declaration, static compatibility) forms a closed call-graph cluster with no edges to the run engine (control flow, dispatch, recording)
Moving StepContract, STEP_CONTRACTS, contract_for, input_schema_for and shallow_contract_check to step_contracts.py requires re-exporting from executor.py so all existing imports resolve unchanged
The expression resolver and run_workflow must remain in executor.py to preserve monkeypatch targets and module-attribute read sites across ~50 test modules
After the split, executor.py drops to ~656 LOC with 144 lines of headroom and step_contracts.py reaches ~181 LOC, both meeting size floor/cap constraints
